title: 第6章 你跟我家夫人干嘛呢？【为盟主“So人

第6章你跟我家夫人干嘛呢？【为盟主“So人艰不拆”加更】
场面似乎有些沉默。
又顿了顿，突然，就听房间里响起了异口同声的一句：“你看那是什么？”
楚梁和明夫人同时左手指向对方的背后，右手则藏在身后。
然后两个人都没有回头。
招数重了。
气氛有些尴尬。
“呵呵。”明夫人笑了笑，“好啊，既然如此，我也不与你废话。自你进屋以来，我引燃的烛火里就藏了幻心毒。你若想要解药，就乖乖离开这里，不要多事。”
“我既然敢进来，自然有所提防，实际上，从夫人点燃香烛的一刻起我就已经屏气内息，不敢沾染。”楚梁道。
明夫人收敛笑容，这一刻她才明白，自己或许有四百个心眼儿……但眼前这看上去年纪不大的少年，比自己只多不少。
“我这些年从未害人，只想与我相公安安稳稳生活。你既然完成了任务，就当无事离开不可以吗？”她的语气变得有些祈求。
楚梁道：“可如此终究不妥。”
下一霎，风云突变！
眼前的柔弱女子陡然窜起，右手一甩，长长的一条乌光长鞭卷向楚梁，如同灵蛇吐信，就要将他一把擒住！
楚梁左手一振，呛啷啷手环化剑，抵住明夫人的长鞭，卷了几下，想要将其斩断。
可那长鞭不知是何材质，蜀山飞剑居然斩之不断。
双方各自拉扯一头，一时陷入角力。
卧室内空间狭小，随着双方真气鼓荡，嘭啪之声不绝，家具装饰纷纷碎裂。
稍稍僵持，明夫人的左手一扬，瞬间化作利爪，挥出三道锋利无匹的黑光。
楚梁闪身躲过，左臂一扬，同样射出一道红芒。

明夫人同样灵活躲闪，但那红芒却仿佛有灵性，在她侧身闪过之时，咻的一声弯转过来，迅速覆盖在她身上。
龟甲缚！
缚妖绳！
在如此近的距离内，缚妖绳的控制当真难以躲闪，明夫人若论修为该比昨晚那猫灵还要高上不少，可还是一击而中！
被层层密密的红绳以龟甲缚的姿态牢牢捆住的明夫人，立刻也站立不稳，跌倒在地，手中黑鞭也落在地上。
但她兀自抬着头，咬牙看向楚梁：“你……”
正在此间战斗落幕之际，就听门外响起了招呼声。
“娘子？刚才是什么动静？你没事吧？”一边喊着，明员外就一边踏进了卧室。
就看到了眼前的一幕。
屋内凌乱不堪，自己的娘子正被以一种奇怪且突出的姿势捆绑着躺在地上……
“啊。”明员外倒退两步，以手扶额，眼神有些懵，不由得出声道：“这这这……你跟我家夫人干嘛呢？”
楚梁赶紧拦住了明员外，让他先不要惊慌，情况不是想象的那样……坐下先平复一下心情，又让他将地上的明夫人也扶起来。
身段婀娜的明夫人经过这样一番捆绑之后，属实是有些诱人，楚梁完全不敢伸手帮忙。
“楚少侠，不打算先将我夫人解开吗？”明员外问道。
“这……”楚梁道：“恐怕不行。”
接着，他又将明夫人是妖物的事情说了出来。
“啊？”明员外闻言大惊，“我夫人是妖物？怎么可能？你……你不要血口喷人！”
楚梁道：“明员外若是不信，我有办法令夫人显出真身。”
“不必了！”自打明员外进门之后一直沉默的明夫人，此时突然顿喝一声，让楚梁将已经摸出来的半块板砖又收了回去。
“相公，其实……我一直不敢与你讲明。”明夫人沉声道：“我的确是妖。”

“啊？这这这……这怎么可能，你如此温柔善良……”明员外仍旧不肯相信。
“谁说妖都是恶妖呢？”明夫人再抬眼时，已经是泪流满面。
“我与父母兄长，自幼生活在城外山中，虽是妖物，也从来不敢害过半条人命。如此生活了近百年，直到有一天，我遇见了你……”
“我？”明员外怔了下。
“不错，就是你。”明夫人温柔地看着他，“你自然是不记得了，谁会记得自己二十年前救过的一条小山猫？”
“啊那是你！”明员外惊呼。
“不错，当时我修行未成，在山中遭遇恶狼，险些丧命。逃到一处林间又被猎人陷阱所夹，那时一个小小少年路过，将我救了下来。”明夫人温柔说道。
“当年我年岁尚小，有一日实在无心读书，便从学堂逃出来，去山中游玩，救下了一只极为可爱的小山猫……我记得！”明员外连连点头：“我还想将你带回家救治，不想你一脱困就跑掉了。”
“之后我努力修行，又过十年，才掌握了化成人形的术法。”明夫人凝视着丈夫，“我连兄长都没敢告知，迫不及待地下山进城去玩，想不到，居然又一下就遇见了你。你长大了，却依旧是那般。”
“我以为那是我们的初见，想不到……原来是第二次。”明员外恍然道。
“是啊，之后我与你相恋、成亲，一切如梦幻一般。我简直不敢相信，做人的生活原来是这般幸福。”明夫人苦笑着，“直到那一天，我怀孕了。”
“夫人你……你能怀孕？”明员外再惊。
“自然是可以的，只是我不敢……”明夫人道：“因为我无法真正的得道化形，我怀着的是妖胎。只要孩子一降生，我的身份也会立刻暴露……于是我瞒着你说回娘家，其实……是偷偷去山中打掉了孩子。”
“夫人你……”明员外握着她的手，也涕泪交加，“纵使你是妖物又如何？这些年你我情深义重，又岂会因为是人是妖而化为虚假吗？”
“想不到，我们的孩子化为怨灵……”明夫人哀声道：“我因此而暴露，想来也是报应吧。”
“不！”明员外哭道：“你何错之有？如果有报应，也该在我身上！”
“这一世能与你有十年的缘分，我已心满意足。”明夫人看向楚梁，“要杀要剐，便朝我来吧。”
“不行，不行！”明员外突然跪倒在地，抓着楚梁，“楚少侠！我愿将全部家产赠予你，换你放我夫妻二人一条生路，求求你了！放过我家夫人吧！”
楚梁看着眼前一对深情男女，目光深邃。
自己如果一剑斩杀了明夫人，对人说起来也合情合理。妖物在人族城池生活，本就是世所不容。

回头还能从白塔之内获得奖励。
若是放过她，拿着明员外的家产离开……也未尝不是一个好选择。即使是凡人财主，这几代积累的家资也不是能轻易获得的。
无论如何都是血赚。
但是……
楚梁毫不犹豫地摇了摇头。
就在夫妻二人的眼神趋于绝望的时候，他又紧接着说道：“若是明夫人果真从未害过人，那你夫妻二人便随我回一趟山门。或许……我可以为明夫人请封。”
感谢“So人艰不拆”成为本书第一个盟主，为好大哥加更一章。
content_en:
Chapter 6 What are you doing with my wife? [Added update for the alliance leader "So people are tough but can't be demolished"]
The scene seemed somewhat silent.
After another pause, suddenly, a unanimous voice was heard in the room: "What do you think that is?"
Chu Liang and Mrs. Ming pointed their left hands behind each other's back at the same time, while their right hands were hidden behind their backs.
Then neither of them looked back.
The trick is heavy.
The atmosphere was a little awkward.
"Haha." Mrs. Ming smiled, "Okay, in that case, I won't talk nonsense to you. Ever since you entered the house, the candle I lit has hidden the phantom heart poison. If you want the antidote, just leave here and be quiet."
"Since I dared to come in, I was naturally wary. In fact, from the moment Madam lit the incense candle, I held my breath and did not dare to contaminate her." Chu Liang said.
Mrs. Ming stopped smiling. Only at this moment did she realize that she might have four hundred thoughts... but the young man in front of her who looked young was only a lot more than herself.
"I have never harmed anyone in these years. I just want to live a stable and stable life with me. Since you have completed your mission, can't you just leave as if nothing happened?" Her tone became a little pleading.
Chu Liang said: "But this is not appropriate after all."
The next moment, the situation suddenly changed!
The weak woman in front of him suddenly jumped up, flicked his right hand, and rolled a long black whip towards Chu Liang, like a spiritual snake spitting a message, she was about to catch him!
Chu Liang waved his left hand, turned the ring into a sword, held it against Mrs. Ming's long whip, rolled it a few times, and tried to cut it off.
But I don’t know what material the long whip was made of, but the Shushan Flying Sword actually kept cutting it.
The two sides pulled each other's ends and fell into a struggle for a while.
The space in the bedroom was small, and as the Qi from both sides surged, there were constant banging sounds, and the furniture and decorations were broken into pieces.
After a slight stalemate, Mrs. Ming raised her left hand, which instantly turned into a sharp claw, and swung out three sharp black lights.
Chu Liang dodged and raised his left arm, shooting out a red light as well.
Mrs. Ming was equally agile in dodging, but the red light seemed to have spirituality. When she dodged sideways, it turned around with a hiss and quickly covered her body.
Tortoise shell binding!
Demon-binding rope!
At such a close distance, it was really difficult to dodge the control of the demon-binding rope. Madam Ming's cultivation was much higher than that of the cat spirit last night, but she still hit it with one blow!
Mrs. Ming, who was tightly bound by layers of dense red ropes in a tortoise-shell manner, immediately became unsteady and fell to the ground, with the black whip in her hand falling to the ground.
But she raised her head and looked at Chu Liang through gritted teeth: "You..."
Just as the battle here was coming to an end, a greeting was heard outside the door.
"Madam? What happened just now? Are you okay?" As he shouted, Ming stepped into the bedroom.
I saw the scene in front of me.
The room was in a mess, and his wife was tied up and lying on the ground in a strange and protruding posture...
"Ah." Officer Ming stepped back two steps, put his hand on his forehead, his eyes were a little confused, and he couldn't help but said: "This, this, this... what are you doing with my wife?"
Chu Liang quickly stopped Ming Mingwai and told him not to panic. The situation was not what he imagined... He sat down to calm down and asked him to help Mrs. Ming up from the ground.
After being tied up like this, the graceful Mrs. Ming was indeed a bit tempting, and Chu Liang didn't dare to reach out to help her at all.
"Young Master Chu, don't you plan to untie my wife first?" Ming Yuanwai asked.
"This..." Chu Liang said, "I'm afraid it won't work."
Then, he told Mrs. Ming that she was a monster.
"Ah?" Officer Ming was shocked when he heard this, "My wife is a monster? How is that possible? You...you don't want to slander anyone!"
Chu Liang said: "If you don't believe me outside the Ming Dynasty, I have a way to make the madam reveal her true identity."
"No need!" Mrs. Ming, who had been silent since Ming Yuan came in, suddenly shouted and asked Chu Liang to take out half of the bricks.He took it back again.
"Ms. sir, actually... I have never dared to explain it to you." Mrs. Ming said in a deep voice, "I am indeed a demon."
"Ah? This, this, this... how is this possible, you are so gentle and kind..." Ming Yuanwai still refused to believe it.
"Who said all monsters are evil monsters?" When Mrs. Ming raised her eyes again, tears were already streaming down her face.
"My parents and brother and I have lived in the mountains outside the city since childhood. Even though we were monsters, we never dared to kill anyone. We lived like this for nearly a hundred years, until one day, I met you..."
"Me?" Ming Yuanwai was startled.
"Yes, it's you." Mrs. Ming looked at him tenderly, "Of course you don't remember. Who would remember a little bobcat that she saved twenty years ago?"
"Ah, that's you!" Ming Yuanwai exclaimed.
"Yes, I had not yet completed my spiritual practice. I encountered a wolf in the mountains and almost died. I escaped to a forest and was caught in a hunter's trap. At that time, a young boy passed by and rescued me." Mrs. Ming said softly.
"When I was still young, one day I really didn't want to study, so I escaped from school, went to the mountains to play, and rescued a very cute little bobcat... I remember it!" Ming Yuanwai nodded repeatedly: "I also want to take you home for treatment, and I don't want you to run away as soon as you get out of trouble."
"After that, I practiced hard, and it took another ten years before I mastered the art of turning into human form." Mrs. Ming stared at her husband, "I didn't even dare to tell my brother, so I couldn't wait to go down the mountain to the city to play. Unexpectedly, I met you again. You have grown up, but you are still like that."
"I thought that was the first time we met, but unexpectedly...it turned out to be the second time." Ming Yuanwai suddenly said.
"Yes, after that, I fell in love with you and got married, and everything was like a dream. I couldn't believe that life as a human being turned out to be so happy." Mrs. Ming smiled bitterly, "Until that day, I became pregnant."
"Madam, you...can you get pregnant?" Officer Ming was shocked again.
"Of course it's possible, but I don't dare..." Mrs. Ming said, "Because I can't truly attain enlightenment and transform, and I'm pregnant with a demon fetus. As soon as the child is born, my identity will be exposed immediately... So I told you to go back to my parents' home without telling you, but in fact... I secretly went to the mountains to abort the child."
"Madam, you..." Officer Ming held her hand and burst into tears, "So what if you are a monster? The deep friendship between you and me over the years will turn into a lie just because you are a human or a monster?"
"Unexpectedly, our child turned into a resentful spirit..." Mrs. Ming lamented: "I was exposed because of this. I guess this is retribution."
"No!" Ming Yuanwai cried, "What's your fault? If there is retribution, it should be on me!"
"I am satisfied to have ten years of fate with you in this life." Mrs. Ming looked at Chu Liang, "If you want to kill or behead, come to me."
"No, no!" Ming Yuanwai suddenly fell to his knees and grabbed Chu Liang, "Young Master Chu! I am willing to give you all my family property in exchange for letting my husband and I live. Please! Let my wife go!"
Chu Liang looked at the loving couple in front of him with deep eyes.
If he killed Mrs. Ming with one sword, it would be reasonable to others. It is unacceptable for monsters to live in human cities.
You can also get rewards from the White Tower when you turn around.
If he let her go and left with Ming Yuan's property... it might not be a bad choice. Even for ordinary wealthy people, the wealth accumulated over the past few generations cannot be easily obtained.
No matter what, it's all blood money.
But...
Chu Liang shook his head without hesitation.
Just when the couple's eyes were becoming desperate, he continued: "If Mrs. Ming has never harmed anyone, then you and your wife will follow me back to the mountain gate. Maybe... I can ask for a seal for Mrs. Ming."
Thanks to "So is a tough guy" for being the first ally in this book and adding an extra chapter to the good brother.
